programme.title: Mystery Woman 8: Wild West Mystery
programme.desc: Former Red River TV series star Clint Lawson's Wild West show is in town, the prize act in the annual festival, which the sponsoring bookshop is presiding over. He strains a leg due to a sabotaged saddle strap. His stand-in, Dogie, is fatally shot while starring in his place, so who was the intended target? Evidence seems to pile up against Clint, so the chief simply jails him without further investigation. However, the bookshop sleuths team digs up dirty secrets from their past and that of other show cast, such as ex-con announcer Jeb Fletcher, Clint's ex-lover Annie whom he promised a movie part like Strother Elam, and Zeke Foster, who secretly deals in illegitimate Red River memorabilia.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 9: Oh Baby
programme.desc: A couple accused of a murder go on the run, leaving their baby in the care of bookshop owner & amateur sleuth Samantha Kinsey. Can Samantha look after the baby and solve the case?

programme.title: Mystery Woman 5: Game Time
programme.desc: Bright youngest graduate Randy (Stinky) Lawrence convinces Samantha to promote his brilliant murder video game in the bookstore in exchange for his help in convincing "old friend" Donald Fiske, a celebrated author, to do a signing session there. To Randy's surprise, it works, but Fiske is poisoned after slipping out angry. Randy is Chief Connors's only suspect. Despite obvious repeated lies, Samantha sets out to prove his innocence. Fiske's greedy ex, Jody, pretends to have convinced him to remarry, yet she never even allowed their teenage son Cameron to set foot in Donald's fine home.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 10: In the Shadows
programme.desc: While searching for a KGB double agent who was about to be exposed by another Russian spy-turned-successful author, mystery bookstore owner Samantha Kinsey and her secretive friend and store manager, Philby are thrust into the murderous world of international espionage.

programme.title: Earthsea
programme.desc: Based on the eponymous series of books by Ursula K. LeGuin, Earthsea centers on a young man whose destiny lies in his own hands; a man with the power to become the greatest sorcerer his world has ever known. The youthful protagonist, Ged, realises he possesses endless magical powers, and embarks on an adventure to master his mystical abilities. His world needs him; the evil ruler of Earthsea, King Tygath, wants to govern the land with an iron fist, but Ged must learn to harness his powers before he can save his people. Two-part fantasy adventure series.

programme.title: An Old Fashioned Thanksgiving
programme.desc: In the late 1880's, a widowed mother of three struggles to keep her family intact and to put food on the table. The oldest daughter sends a letter to her estranged, very wealthy grandmother urging her assistance, much to her mother's disapproval. When the grandmother arrives, old wounds are opened but eventually healed. From a story by Louisa May Alcott. Stars Jacqueline Bisset, Ted Atherton, Tatiana Maslany, Helene Joy, Paula Boudreau, and Michael Barbuto.

programme.title: Stranded
programme.desc: David Robinson is being shipped off to a penal colony. His wife and kids are allowed to accompany him. A storm strikes the ship and the family (save for one son, Jacob) are trapped below deck. Jacob is raised by pirates, and the family gets out of the boat and on to land, salvaging as much as they can from the boat, including dogs, chickens, and muskets. They learn to survive and build a shelter on land. Then, Jacob's pirates kidnap Emily, the daughter of a sea-captain. She escapes onto the island and becomes a love interest with Fritz and Ernst. Jacob is reunited with his family during a battle with the pirates over Emily, and she is returned to her father. In the end, the family goes their own ways, some staying on the island, some going home.

programme.title: Amazonia
programme.desc: Explore the incredible wildlife of the Amazon rainforest. It is one of the most amazing natural environments on the planet, inhabited by a huge variety of animal species, including jaguars, otters, tarantulas, eagles, dolphins and more. Join to see what goes on in the jungle.

programme.title: Day of the Dragon
programme.desc: The clock starts just before sunrise - when the temperature begins to rise. It's hard work being the world's biggest lizard on Rinca island. Competition is so fierce he can't afford to slow down. For the biggest male on the island, an ever- warming environment and shrinking hunting grounds threaten his survival across every hour of the day.

programme.title: The Hidden Kingdoms of China
programme.desc: China is the world's third biggest country by area. It has second largest economy on the planet and the largest population. But this documentary series takes you away from China's highly-populated mega-cities and explores the more remote locations of this fascinating country. Visiting forests, jungles, mountains and grasslands, we take a rare glimpse at parts of China that usually remain unseen. We see the wildlife that live amongst the stunning beauty of the Chinese landscapes - and how they survive in often demanding situations. With golden snub-nosed monkeys, bears, bees, elephants and the legendary giant panda. The Hidden Kingdoms of China is narrated by Michelle Yeoh.

programme.title: Ultimate Animals Compilations
programme.desc: They are the backbone of the natural world, and in this documentary series, we explore some of the most interesting and amazing animals that roam our planet. Each episode focusses on two special creatures, revealing their characteristics and behaviours, and feature interviews with various experts alongside stunning video footage of the animals in their natural environments. A fascinating series that explores the animals' instincts and anatomies using state-of-the-art cameras and graphics, the creatures featured include polar bears, tigers, octopuses, elephants and orangutans.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The long-awaited spinoff of the legendary The Incredible Dr. Pol franchise has finally hatched! Spearheaded by Dr. Pol and his son Charles, the Pol familys three generations are all joining forces to grow their animal loving empire and take on an ambitious new project: transforming 350-acres of undeveloped land into a fully functional family farm!

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: After getting the tractor stuck in mud, Charles and Ben need a quick solution to plant hayseed in their field to provide food for their incoming animals. The Pol family must quickly figure out why their field is so wet even though it hasnt rained in days. Meanwhile, Dr. Pol helps Charles and Beth set up their first beehive colonies on the new farm.

programme.title: Animal Fight Club
programme.desc: Documentary series featuring fearsome fights between the biggest and the baddest animals on planet. Watch the animals fighting for their food, territory, rights and life. Follow the drama and adrenaline of the toughest and fearcest fights in savannah, jungles and water. It is an ultimate survival with no rules whatsoever. Uncover the extraordinary motivations and strategies used by the animal world.

programme.title: Africa's Deadly Kingdom
programme.desc: Instead of providing in-depth examinations of the fauna of the continent of Africa, this nature series alternatively focuses on the hostile and unforgiving landscapes that the animals have to survive in. Africa is home to some of the most extreme and diverse environments on the planet, from arid deserts to lush rainforests, mountainous peaks to mighty river and lake systems, savannah grasslands to rugged coastline. This show explores these different regions and documents how the plants and creatures that inhabit them endure places where there are few resources of food and water or where competition is rife and life-threatening. The unique demands placed on these plants and animals have resulted in the development of incredibly resilient species that remain successful against all the odds.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: Reality show follows Dutch-born veterinarian Jan Pol, his family and employees' everyday. Dr Pol has seen it all, treating numerous patients every single day, his daily routine is more than 12 hours but nothing can stop him from being devoted to his patients.

Africa is home to some of the most extreme and diverse environments on the planet, from arid deserts to lush rainforests, mountainous peaks to mighty river and lake systems, savannah grasslands to rugged coastline. This show explores these different regions and documents how the plants and creatures that inhabit them endure places where there are few resources of food and water or where competition is rife and life-threatening. The unique demands placed on these plants and animals have resulted in the development of incredibly resilient species that remain successful against all the odds.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: It's summer in Michigan, which means time to bale some hay! It's a grueling process, but Dr. Pol, Charles, and Ben manage to mow their hayfield, which is the first step in baling. But a surprise rainstorm could ruin this year's hay haul. They hope for sun, so their crop doesn't spoil before they can bale. Meanwhile, the Pol's bring in their next animal to the farm - an emu!

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: It's the county fair season! The Pol's plan to get at least two cows and six sheep at the auction, but they have a lot to do before that can happen. First up, they must install a new perimeter fence. Charles and Ben think they are off to a good start, but when Dr. Pol points out how sneaky sheep can be, their workload doubles. Meanwhile, Beth is hoping for a goat at the small animal auction.

programme.title: The Hidden Kingdoms of China
programme.desc: China is the world's third biggest country by area. It has second largest economy on the planet and the largest population. But this documentary series takes you away from China's highly-populated mega-cities and explores the more remote locations of this fascinating country. Visiting forests, jungles, mountains and grasslands, we take a rare glimpse at parts of China that usually remain unseen. We see the wildlife that live amongst the stunning beauty of the Chinese landscapes - and how they survive in often demanding situations. With golden snub-nosed monkeys, bears, bees, elephants and the legendary giant panda. The Hidden Kingdoms of China is narrated by Michelle Yeoh.

programme.title: Africa's Hidden Wonders
programme.desc: A land full of extreme environments and teeming with iconic wildlife, Africa holds a fascination like no other continent. This series takes the viewer on a journey from harsh desert landscapes to towering peaks, and from vast, sprawling grasslands to raging river torrents. The three episodes cover the mist-covered jungles and mountains of Rwanda and the great apes who call it home; the largest desert in the world, the Sahara, where the scarcity of water and food make life a daily challenge for the creatures who compete for them; and the cradle of humanity, Ethiopia, a weather-ravaged land full of natural beauty and unique wildlife.

programme.title: Eternal Enemies: Lions And Hyenas (Revealed)
programme.desc: The Joubert's Emmy winning film is back with stunning remastered footage. Propelled by Jeremy Irons gripping narration, Eternal Enemies reveals the story of conflict between lions and hyenas, relatively unknown or even suspected in the scientific world before this. The intense relationship and enduring rivalry between the two species play out in a battle of survival. Narrated by Jeremy Irons.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: Reality show follows Dutch-born veterinarian Jan Pol, his family and employees' everyday. Jan Pol and his wife Diane started their own practice in Weidman, Michigan, Pol Veterinary Services, back in in 1981. Dr Pol takes a good care of every family pet and head of livestock no matter what size or condition and is a true legend in the community. Dr Pol has seen it all, treating numerous patients every single day, his daily routine is more than 12 hours but nothing can stop him from being devoted to his patients.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pol's need to break ground for a new outbuilding that will house incoming livestock and Charles has dreamt up an outrageous idea of what that structure can be - and it just may be just crazy enough to work. At the auction, the Pol's are hoping to purchase sheep and cows, but the skyrocketing bids threaten their big plans.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The bidding is live at the large animal auction! The Pol's are working towards their goal of bringing home sheep and cows to their farm. Any animals they win will be delivered to the farm in just three days, so the pressure is on to get the sheep hut finished in time - and there is a ton left to do. Meanwhile, Beth and Charles are concerned about the low activity in their beehives.

programme.title: Cat Wars: Lion vs Cheetah
programme.desc: Caught on tape in Africa's wild Serengeti is a stunning act of violence between two top predators. Three cheetahs are brutally attacked by two male lions - the first time an attack like this has ever been filmed. Now, filmmaker Leo Kuenkel, who witnessed the attack, is trying to make sense of it. Was this a once-in-a-lifetime "perfect storm" event? Or do these iconic African cats have a deep-set, sinister reason to fight to the death?

programme.title: Land of the Iberian Lynx
programme.desc: Sierra Morena is a mountain range of climatic extremes. The harsh winter puts the lynxes of the Jandula River Valley to the test. Golden eagles, otters, wild boars and cormorants struggle to survive in the land of the Iberian lynx.

programme.title: Land of the Iberian Lynx
programme.desc: Spring rains bring new opportunities and hope to the land of the Iberian lynx. But for the female lynxes of the valley, it is always a challenge to raise their cubs. The series follows the lynxes in their struggle for survival, from the thrill of the hunt to the tender moments of parenting, and also witnesses their coexistence with other animals like majestic golden eagles or powerful deer.

programme.title: Future Cat
programme.desc: With cutting-edge visual effects, experts discuss the adaptations possible extreme scenarios might bring about in the big cats.

programme.title: A Leopard's Legacy
programme.desc: A confident and powerful leopardess named Olimba, rules over an exceptionally large area along Zambia's Luangwa river. She is a formidable hunter, a courageous ruler, and a devoted mother. She's just given birth to two tiny cubs, and as she faces the challenging task of motherhood, it's a constant battle to hunt successfully, to defend her prime territory, and to protect her cubs against her enemies.

programme.desc: The great outdoors: fresh air, beautiful forests and incredible wildlife. But if you go down to the woods today, be prepared for every kind of surprise. Take a hike into the wilderness to discover how to avoid a run-in with a bison and when to duck if you see a deer.

programme.title: Close Encounters of the Wild Kind
programme.desc: Soon two-thirds of the global population will be living in cities, leaving wild animals to develop a whole new set of street smarts. Whether that's a hungry bear raiding a supermarket, a street gang of monkeys committing daylight robbery, or a raccoon figuring out how to open a wildlife-proof bin - from Delhi to New York, these guys will stop at nothing.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: This family farm needs a barn! The Pols are ready to tackle their next big project: preserving and carefully taking down a 100-year-old barn since, with every piece they remove makes the barn weaker and weaker. There is no room for error if they are going to transport these irreplaceable beams back to the farm and restore it to its former glory.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pols have reached the most dangerous stage of disassembling the 100-year-old barn: taking down the beams. Then, if all goes well, theyll transport the beams back to the farm. Each part of this process must be carefully orchestrated to protect these irreplaceable beams. Meanwhile, Beth tries training Clovis after he runs away from the farm.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.desc: Large carnivores such as leopards, lions and hyenas are in constant competition for their next meal for their pack in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. Following the lives of the wise old leopard Kamuti who rained over the prime territory in the Luangwa Valley for 10 years, a six-week-old lion cub and a clan of spotted hyenas, this documentary series allows audiences to see these magnificent animals like never before. With up-close imagery of animals existing within Luangwa Valley and their life in the wild, feel a part of the pack with Africa's Hunters.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: Lions kill four buffaloes in a stampede, while in another drying river a buffalo fights off five of the big cats. As the dry winter looms, heading out on a game drive means checking in at all the remaining waterholes. This is where the action plays out. Each event is unpacked and explained, offering a highly charged, emotional and informative ride.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: Hungry crocs battle a dangerous pod of hippos. The hippos take on a group of male lions. A honey badger battles for life against leopards, and wild dogs cause chaos everywhere they go! In the wilds of Southern Africa, the long, dry winter brings a desperation to the animals who live here. Prepare yourself for a highly charged, emotional and informative ride.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: Reality show follows Dutch-born veterinarian Jan Pol, his family and employees' everyday. Jan Pol and his wife Diane started their own practice in Weidman, Michigan, Pol Veterinary Services, back in in 1981. Dr Pol takes a good care of every family pet and head of livestock no matter what size or condition and is a true legend in the community. Dr Pol has seen it all, treating numerous patients every single day, his daily routine is more than 12 hours but nothing can stop him from being devoted to his patients.

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: A prequel to SpongeBob SquarePants, featuring the beloved characters as children, spending their summertime at Camp Coral having fun doing typical camp activities like building campfires, catching jellyfish, and swimming in Lake Yuckymuck, causing a bit of trouble and chaos on the side. SpongeBob SquarePants is a ten-year-old with a red cap, goofy and friendly as he's always been. All other characters such as Mr. Krabs, Mrs. Puff, SpongeBob's nemesis Plankton, and Karen are a part of this adventure as well.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: A prequel to SpongeBob SquarePants, featuring the beloved characters as children, spending their summertime at Camp Coral having fun doing typical camp activities like building campfires, catching jellyfish, and swimming in Lake Yuckymuck, causing a bit of trouble and chaos on the side. SpongeBob SquarePants is a ten-year-old with a red cap, goofy and friendly as he's always been. programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Welcome to the Patrick Star Show hosted by Patrick himself and revolving around his extraordinary family and his own bizzare fantasies. Get to know his family, his Dad Cecil Star, his Mom Bunny Star, his sister Squidina Star, and GrandPat Star, and find out where his charm and eccentricity come from.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

Timmy's greenness in making his wishes causes troubles and he has to "unwish" them together with his fairy godparents to avoid possible disasters. Enjoy Timmy's fantastic adventures in the world of fairies, dragons, unicorns and dwarfs.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Avatar: The Last Airbender is an American animated TV series, set in an Asiatic-like world. Some people there can manipulate the classical elements with psychokinetic variants of the Chinese martial arts. Unlike anybody else, 12-year-old Aang, the Avatar and last survivor of his nation, the Air Nomads, is capable of bending all four elements, his mission is to maintain harmony between the world's four nations. His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

programme.title: Bundeslyga. Augsburgo FC - Miuncheno "Bayern"
programme.desc: Germany has the most attended football league in the world, in the Bundesliga. We bring these authentic fab experiences to your living room with all the key moments of the 2019-20 season, to ensure that your appetite for German football is well and truly met. The likes of Borussia Dortmund and Bayern Munich are met with stern competition this season, as RB Leipzig look to build on their third-placed finish from last season. This programme brings all the games of the german top-flight into one place, so that you can easily catch up with the week's action. As we reach the business end-of-the-season, watch the victors and losers dictate the final table. With relegation spots and Champions League places yet to be decided, it promises to be a rather exciting conclusion for all those concerned.

programme.title: La Liga. Vitorijos-Gasteiso „Alaves“ - Madrido „Atletico“
programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

programme.title: Anglijos futbolo lygos čempionatas. „Middlesbrough“ - „Sheffield United“
programme.desc: The English Football League Championship or the "EFL" as it is otherwise referred to, is the stepping stone from the wilderness of English football, to the riches associated with the promised land, that is the 'English Premier League'. In keeping with traditions of this club championship, we bring you first-hand, live coverage of developments for this division. Touted as one of the hardest leagues to manoeuvre out of, it was founded in 2004 and has truly delivered with its play-off system, offering a whole new dimension of entertainment, compared to other leagues out there. From "Sleeping Giants" such as Nottingham Forest & Sheffield Wednesday, to the jostling pack of Preston & Brentford, marquee match-ups every week will decide the final Championship standings, come the end of May.

programme.title: Prancūzijos "Ligue 1" futbolo lyga. Liono "Olympic" - Marselio „Olympique“
programme.desc: PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. Ligue 1 is currently full of well-organised football teams and incredible European talent, who are a complement to the sport. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. With the latter coming from a principality, Ligue 1 is another example of a domestic league that provides cross-border competition. From southern wine-growing regions such as Bordeaux, to the historically renowned capital of Paris, we cover the whole of France.

Touted as one of the hardest leagues to manoeuvre out of, it was founded in 2004 and has truly delivered with its play-off system, offering a whole new dimension of entertainment, compared to other leagues out there. From "Sleeping Giants" such as Nottingham Forest & Sheffield Wednesday, to the jostling pack of Preston & Brentford, marquee match-ups every week will decide the final Championship standings, come the end of May.

programme.title: Football: Saudi Pro League
programme.desc: The Saudi Pro League (SPL) is the top-tier football league in Saudi Arabia, featuring the country's best clubs and top international players. Established in 1976, it has grown into one of the most competitive leagues in Asia. The SPL attracts global attention with high-profile signings, intense rivalries, and a passionate fan base.

programme.title: Football: LaLiga
programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

programme.title: Football: Bundesliga
programme.desc: Germany has the most attended football league in the world, in the Bundesliga. We bring these authentic fab experiences to your living room with all the key moments of the 2019-20 season, to ensure that your appetite for German football is well and truly met. The likes of Borussia Dortmund and Bayern Munich are met with stern competition this season, as RB Leipzig look to build on their third-placed finish from last season. This programme brings all the games of the german top-flight into one place, so that you can easily catch up with the week's action. As we reach the business end-of-the-season, watch the victors and losers dictate the final table. With relegation spots and Champions League places yet to be decided, it promises to be a rather exciting conclusion for all those concerned.

programme.title: Football: French Ligue 1
programme.desc: PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. Ligue 1 is currently full of well-organised football teams and incredible European talent, who are a complement to the sport. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. With the latter coming from a principality, Ligue 1 is another example of a domestic league that provides cross-border competition. From southern wine-growing regions such as Bordeaux, to the historically renowned capital of Paris, we cover the whole of France.

Peter e Kyle Reynolds sono due fratelli gemelli che si trovano, ormai adulti, davanti a una sconcertante verità: il loro padre biologico non è affatto morto ma nessuno, nemmeno la loro mamma Helen, ne conosce l'identità. Decidono quindi di attraversare gli Stati Uniti con la speranza di rintracciare l'uomo. Ma per farlo dovranno ascoltare tutte le avventure sessuali vissute dalla focosa e libertina Helen nei disinibiti anni Settanta. Nel cast i premi Oscar J.K. Simmons e Christopher Walken.

programme.desc: Simon West ('Con Air') dirige Nicolas Cage in un action con Josh Lucas e Malin Akerman. Il bottino non e' mai stato recuperato, ma il suo vecchio socio e' convinto che Will sappia dove sia finito. E per recuperarlo ha un solo modo per convincerlo a collaborare: rapisce sua figlia Allison e la tiene prigioniera nel bagagliaio di un taxi. Se vuole rivedere la ragazza sana e salva, Will deve trovare 10 milioni di dollari in 12 ore.

programme.desc: 7 David di Donatello per l'opera di Maura Delpero premiata anche a Venezia. La Seconda guerra mondiale volge al termine quando la stabilità di una famiglia trentina è stravolta.

programme.title: La La Land
programme.desc: 6 Oscar al musical di Damien Chazelle con Ryan Gosling ed Emma Stone, premiata a Venezia. Mia, aspirante attrice, s'innamora di Sebastian, pianista jazz che sogna di aprire un night club.

programme.title: Bastardi senza gloria
programme.desc: Quentin Tarantino rilegge la Seconda guerra mondiale con Brad Pitt e Christoph Waltz, premiato a Cannes e con l'Oscar. Un gruppo di soldati Usa e' inviato a Parigi per uccidere Hitler.

programme.title: L'orto americano
programme.desc: Dal suo romanzo, Pupi Avanti dirige Filippo Scotti in un film dalle atmosfere sospese. Nei giorni della Liberazione, un ragazzo si innamora di un'infermiera dell'esercito americano.

programme.title: Vermiglio
programme.desc: 7 David di Donatello per l'opera di Maura Delpero premiata anche a Venezia. La Seconda guerra mondiale volge al termine quando la stabilità di una famiglia trentina è stravolta.

programme.title: Era mio figlio (2024)
programme.desc: Richard Gere e Diane Kruger in una pellicola sul rimpianto di Savi Gabizon. Un ricco magnate scopre di aver avuto un figlio, morto in un incidente, e decide di scavare nel suo passato.

programme.title: La La Land
programme.desc: 6 Oscar al musical di Damien Chazelle con Ryan Gosling ed Emma Stone, premiata a Venezia. Mia, aspirante attrice, s'innamora di Sebastian, pianista jazz che sogna di aprire un night club.

programme.title: La zona d'interesse
programme.desc: Premio a Cannes e 2 Oscar per l'intensa opera di Jonathan Glazer. Un solo muro separa la quiete borghese della famiglia del comandante di Auschwitz dal campo di concentramento.

programme.title: L'esercito delle 12 scimmie
programme.desc: Visionario fanta-action di Terry Gilliam con Bruce Willis e Brad Pitt. Anno 2035: un ergastolano viene mandato nel passato per scoprire le cause dell'epidemia che ha decimato l'umanita'.

programme.title: Killers of the Flower Moon
programme.desc: Monumentale opera di Martin Scorsese con Leonardo DiCaprio e Robert De Niro. Una misteriosa serie di omicidi tra i nativi americani Osage obbliga il governo a intervenire.

programme.title: The Independent: Complotto per la Casa Bianca
programme.desc: John Cena e Brian Cox nella pellicola targata Sky Original. Una giovane giornalista scopre una cospirazione che coinvolge un candidato alla Presidenza degli Stati Uniti.

programme.title: Still Life
programme.desc: Struggente riflessione sulla vita premiata a Venezia. Il lavoro di John May e' organizzare il funerale delle persone morte in solitudine. Il suo ultimo incarico gli farà scoprire se stesso.

programme.title: Babygirl
programme.desc: Coppa Volpi a Venezia a Nicole Kidman in un dramma erotico con Harris Dickinson e Antonio Banderas. Una donna sposata, amministratice delegata di un'azienda importante, inizia una relazione clandestina con un giovane stagista che la trascina in una spirale di perversione.

programme.title: Attrazione fatale
programme.desc: Passione pericolosa fra Glenn Close e Michael Douglas in un cult degli anni '80, firmato dal regista di "9 settimane e 1/2". Dan Gallagher, un avvocato di New York felicemente sposato, tradisce la moglie con una sconosciuta, che non si accontenta di una sola notte e comincia a perseguitarlo rendendogli la vita un inferno. Le provocazioni della psicopatica si fanno sempre piu' asfissianti, fino a quando la donna comunica a Dan di essere incinta, rifiutandosi di abortire. La sua prossima sfida sara' recarsi a casa dell'uomo per conoscere la moglie...

programme.title: The Apprentice - Alle origini di Trump
programme.desc: Sebastian Stan è l’imprenditore e Presidente USA nel biopic di Ali Abbasi. New York, anni 70: l'ascesa del magnate segnata dall'incontro con l'avvocato Roy Cohn (Jeremy Strong).

programme.title: La stanza del figlio
programme.desc: Palma d'Oro a Cannes per la toccante pellicola di Nanni Moretti, anche protagonista con Laura Morante. Legami familiari attraversati da luci e ombre, fino all’irruzione del dolore.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Premiati a Venezia...
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova ci raccontano quattro pellicole premiate a Venezia 2024, in prima visione nella collezione 'Film da Leoni', dal 27 agosto al 6 settembre.

programme.title: The Independent: Complotto per la Casa Bianca
programme.desc: John Cena e Brian Cox nella pellicola targata Sky Original. Una giovane giornalista scopre una cospirazione che coinvolge un candidato alla Presidenza degli Stati Uniti.

programme.title: Ariaferma
programme.desc: Toni Servillo e Silvio Orlando nel dramma carcerario di Leonardo Di Costanzo che indaga il delicato rapporto tra secondini e detenuti, premiato con 2 David di Donatello 2022.

programme.title: The Last Rifleman - Ritorno in Normandia
programme.desc: Pellicola Sky Original con Pierce Brosnan protagonista. Un veterano della Seconda guerra mondiale fugge dalla casa di cura per partecipare al 75 anniversario dello sbarco in Normandia.

programme.title: American Gigolo
programme.desc: Il film cult degli anni '80 che ha consacrato il mito sexy di Richard Gere. Un affascinante gigolo' finisce nei guai quando una delle sue clienti viene ritrovata barbaramente uccisa.

programme.title: Better Man
programme.desc: Michael Gracey confeziona un originale biopic su Robbie Williams, rappresentato sullo schermo da una scimmia: da timido bambino diventerà una pop star internazionale.

programme.title: L'ombra del giorno
programme.desc: Giuseppe Piccioni dirige Riccardo Scamarcio e Benedetta Porcaroli. Ascoli Piceno, 1938: un ristoratore filofascista s'innamora della sua nuova cameriera. Ma la ragazza nasconde un segreto.

programme.title: La migliore offerta
programme.desc: Giuseppe Tornatore dirige il premio Oscar Geoffrey Rush in un'intensa pellicola. La vita di un antiquario viene sconvolta dal segreto nascosto nei sotterranei di una villa.

programme.title: Povere creature!
programme.desc: Londra XIX secolo: una donna morta suicida nel Tamigi viene riportata in vita da uno scienziato. Bramosa di conoscere e totalmente libera, la rediviva creatura inizia un instancabile percorso di formazione e di emancipazione.

programme.title: Nuovomondo
programme.desc: Leone d'argento per Emanuele Crialese che dirige Charlotte Gainsbourg in un dramma sull'immigrazione. Inizi del '900: una famiglia siciliana parte per l'America in cerca di fortuna.

programme.title: Kiss Kiss Bang Bang
programme.desc: Ricatti e omicidi in un thriller con Val Kilmer, Robert Downey Jr e Michelle Monaghan. Una serie di coincidenze porta un ladro a recitare in un film. Finirà in un torbido giro.

programme.title: Il colosso di Rodi
programme.desc: Lo spettacolare esordio alla regia di Sergio Leone. Sull'isola greca un gruppo di congiurati si ribella contro il Re Serse, mentre i Fenici stanno per attaccare la citta'.

programme.title: Piccolo corpo
programme.desc: Esordio alla regia di Laura Samani, premiata ai David di Donatello. Dopo aver perso sua figlia alla nascita, Agata parte alla volta di un santuario per battezzare la sua creatura.

programme.title: Il seme del fico sacro
programme.desc: Premio a Cannes e una candidatura agli Oscar per la coraggiosa opera di Mohammad Rasoulof. Nell'Iran delle proteste giovanili, l'unione di una famiglia viene messa a dura prova.

programme.title: Amistad
programme.desc: Il grande Steven Spielberg dirige i premi Oscar Anthony Hopkins e Morgan Freeman in un appassionante dramma storico-giudiziario. 1839: un gruppo di schiavi, imbarcati sulla nave Amistad per essere venduti, si ribellano e uccidono parte dell'equipaggio tentando il dirottamento verso l'Africa. Giunti su un'isola verranno pero' attaccati da una nave americana rischiando di essere schiavizzati ancora. Seconda nomination agli Oscar per Anthony Hopkins nel ruolo di un Presidente degli Stati Uniti (qui interpreta John Q. Adams) dopo quella ottenuta per "Nixon".

programme.title: Povere creature!
programme.desc: Londra XIX secolo: una donna morta suicida nel Tamigi viene riportata in vita da uno scienziato. Bramosa di conoscere e totalmente libera, la rediviva creatura inizia un instancabile percorso di formazione e di emancipazione.

programme.title: Il filo nascosto
programme.desc: Oscar ai costumi per la pellicola di Paul Thomas Anderson con un formidabile Daniel Day-Lewis. Londra, anni 50: la vita di un rinomato stilista viene turbata dall'infatuazione per una donna.

programme.title: Emma
programme.desc: Da un romanzo di Jane Austen, una storia di amicizia e intese amorose con il premio Oscar Gwyneth Paltrow. Nell'Inghilterra dell'inizio '800, una giovane aristocratica decide di aiutare una ragazza semplice e timida a cercare un marito. Per due volte crede di averle trovato l'uomo giusto, ma entrambe le volte finira' per sbagliarsi. Questo suo voler decidere dei destini altrui la mettera' nei guai finche', fra sorprese e malintesi, cadra' lei stessa vittima delle maglie dell'amore. Premio Oscar per la miglior colonna sonora all'inglese Rachel Portman.

programme.title: Argo
programme.desc: 3 Oscar e 2 Golden Globe al thriller diretto e interpretato da Ben Affleck. Iran, 1979: uno specialista della Cia attua un geniale piano per liberare un gruppo di ostaggi.

programme.title: E' stato il figlio
programme.desc: Toni Servillo in una vicenda grottesca di Daniele Cipri'. Dopo la morte della figlia, una famiglia palermitana spende il risarcimento in una Mercedes. L'automobile segnera' la loro rovina.

programme.title: La stanza accanto
programme.desc: Tilda Swinton e Julianne Moore in un dramma di Pedro Almodovar, Leone d'Oro a Venezia. Martha è una reporter di guerra malata di cancro che ha deciso di suicidarsi con una pillola. Ingrid, una sua amica di infanzia, passa con lei gli ultimi giorni prima del momento fatale.

programme.title: The Way Back
programme.desc: Peter Weir racconta un'impresa disperata in un film con Jim Sturgess, Ed Harris e Colin Farrell. Evasi da un lager siberiano, un gruppo di uomini intraprende una fuga in condizioni estreme.

programme.title: Il colore viola (2023)
programme.desc: Adattamento musicale del romanzo di Alice Walker, che aveva gia' dato vita nel 1985 alla celebre pellicola di Steven Spielberg. Nel cast Taraji P. Henson, Danielle Brooks e Fantasia Barrino.

programme.title: Harry Potter e il principe mezzosangue
programme.desc: David Yates dirige la sesta avventura della saga. Un manuale misterioso insegna a Harry Potter i segreti della magia nera, ma per sconfiggere Voldemort avrà bisogno di Lumacorno.

programme.title: Harry Potter e i doni della morte: Parte I
programme.desc: Prima parte dell'adattamento dell'ultimo romanzo di J.K. Rowling. Insieme a Hermione e Ron, Harry deve trovare e distruggere gli horcrux, oggetti contenenti l'anima del Signore Oscuro.

programme.title: Harry Potter e i doni della morte: Parte II
programme.desc: Gran finale della saga in un tripudio di effetti speciali. Alla ricerca degli ultimi horcrux, Harry torna a Hogwarts, ma Voldemort ha scoperto la sua missione...

programme.title: Animali fantastici e dove trovarli
programme.desc: Oscar ai costumi per lo spin-off della saga di Harry Potter, scritto da J.K. Rowling. Il magizoologo Newt Scamander (Eddie Redmayne) arriva a New York con un inconsueto bagaglio...

programme.title: Harry Potter 20th Anniversary...
programme.desc: Per celebrare il 20esimo anniversario del primo film del franchise, una retrospettiva che propone la reunion fra Daniel Radcliffe, Rupert Grint, Emma Watson, i registi e altri membri del cast.

programme.title: Harry Potter e la pietra filosofale
programme.desc: Primo capitolo della saga con Daniel Radcliffe. Dotato di poteri speciali, il piccolo Harry Potter inizia la sua avventura alla scuola di magia di Hogwarts e affronta il malvagio Voldemort.

programme.title: Harry Potter e la camera dei segreti
programme.desc: Secondo capitolo sul giovane mago creato dalla scrittrice J.K. Rowling. Harry affronta una diabolica presenza che pietrifica le sue vittime e scopre il segreto di una stanza misteriosa.

programme.desc: Daniel Radcliffe, Rupert Grint, Emma Thompson e Gary Oldman nel terzo capitolo della saga. Harry scopre che il pericoloso criminale Sirius Black sta arrivando a Hogwarts per ucciderlo.

programme.title: David Holmes - Il ragazzo che è sopravvissuto
programme.desc: La storia di David Holmes, stuntman nei film di Harry Potter, paralizzato dopo un incidente sul set. Una riflessione sulla resistenza e la forza dei legami.

programme.title: Dolittle
programme.desc: Robert Downey Jr. e Antonio Banderas in un’epica avventura ispirata al personaggio dei romanzi firmati da Hugh Lofting. Inghilterra vittoriana: un medico in grado di parlare con gli animali salpa verso un’isola leggendaria alla ricerca di una cura per guarire la regina.

programme.title: Megamind
programme.desc: Allegra parodia del mondo dei supereroi in un gioiello d'animazione DreamWorks. Annoiato dalla mancanza di un rivale, Megamind ne crea uno grazie al dna del nemico sconfitto, Metroman.

programme.title: Pan - Viaggio sull'isola che non c'è
programme.desc: Joe Wright rilancia il mito di Peter Pan in un'avventura fantastica con Hugh Jackman. Catapultato in un mondo abitato da guerrieri, pirati e fate, un dodicenne orfano diventa un eroe.

programme.title: Mister Link
programme.desc: Golden Globe per il miglior film d’animazione. Mister Link, gigante e peloso ‘anello mancante’ tra uomo e scimmia, chiede a un esploratore di aiutarlo a ritrovare la sua famiglia.

programme.title: Transformers One
programme.desc: Il prequel totalmente animato della saga sci-fi e' un'origin story che narra l'amicizia dei futuri nemici giurati Optimus Prime e Megatron, in fuga dalla Cyberton sotterranea, e il momento in cui acquisiscono i loro poteri.

programme.title: Viaggio nell'isola misteriosa
programme.desc: Dwayne Johnson e Michael Caine in un'avventura dal romanzo di Jules Verne. Dopo aver decriptato un messaggio, un ragazzo e il suo patrigno scoprono un'isola abitata da incredibili animali.

programme.title: Tartarughe Ninja
programme.desc: Le valorose tartarughe mutanti tornano in un action mozzafiato con Megan Fox. Le sorti di New York, soggiogata da Shredder, sono nelle mani dell'eroico quartetto e di una bella reporter.

programme.title: I Croods 2 - Una nuova era
programme.desc: Seconda avventura animata per gli sprizzanti cavernicoli. Dopo aver accolto il giovane Guy, i Croods vanno in cerca di un luogo chiamato ‘casa’. Una volta trovato, dovranno fare i conti con i suoi abitanti, l'evoluto clan dei Superior, finché una nuova minaccia non porterà le due famiglie a unire le loro forze.

programme.title: Balto e Togo - La leggenda
programme.desc: Scritto, diretto e interpretato da Brian Presley, film d’avventura ispirato a una storia vera. Alaska, 1925. Nella cittadina di Nome la difterite colpisce i bambini. Con i cani da slitta Balto e Togo, Leonhard e altri uomini del villaggio partono alla ricerca del siero curativo.

programme.title: C'è tempo
programme.desc: Stefano Fresi in una commedia 'on the road' di Walter Veltroni. Alla morte del padre, un quarantenne 'osservatore di arcobaleni' scopre di avere un fratellastro minorenne.

programme.title: Mia e il leone bianco
programme.desc: Daniah De Villiers e Mélanie Laurent nella toccante storia di un legame impossibile. Trasferitasi in Sudafrica con i genitori, Mia stringe amicizia con un cucciolo di leone bianco.

programme.title: Pil's Adventures - Un regno da salvare
programme.desc: Animazione targata Sky Original ambientata nel Medioevo. L'orfanella Pil vive ai margini del regno. Quando pero' il trono viene usurpato, tocca a lei aiutare il legittimo erede.

programme.title: Oggi è sempre Natale
programme.desc: Un pizzico di mistero per una divertente commedia. Un ragazzo finisce in un loop temporale e rivive più volte il giorno di Natale in cui non ha ricevuto il regalo sperato.

programme.title: Mister Link
programme.desc: Golden Globe per il miglior film d’animazione. Mister Link, gigante e peloso ‘anello mancante’ tra uomo e scimmia, chiede a un esploratore di aiutarlo a ritrovare la sua famiglia.

programme.title: Sing
programme.desc: Dai creatori di "Cattivissimo me", una commedia musicale sulla magia del palcoscenico. In un mondo interamente abitato da animali, il koala Buster Moon possiede uno storico teatro caduto ormai in disgrazia dopo i fasti del passato. Per risollevarne le sorti, organizza una gara di canto radunando una serie di incredibili aspiranti star. A contendersi la palma del migliore ci sono Mike, un topolino imbroglione, la timida elefantessa Meena e Rosita, una scrofa con 25 maialini da accudire. E poi Johnny e Ash: il primo e' un gorilla figlio di un gangster; la seconda e' una grintosa cantante punk.

programme.title: Il Grinch
programme.desc: Animazione campione d'incassi targata Illumination tratta dal racconto del Dr. Seuss. Lo scontroso mostriciattolo verde odia lo spirito del Natale ed elabora un piano per sabotare la festa.

programme.title: Mia e il leone bianco
programme.desc: Daniah De Villiers e Mélanie Laurent nella toccante storia di un legame impossibile. Trasferitasi in Sudafrica con i genitori, Mia stringe amicizia con un cucciolo di leone bianco.

programme.title: Balto e Togo - La leggenda
programme.desc: Scritto, diretto e interpretato da Brian Presley, film d’avventura ispirato a una storia vera. Alaska, 1925. Nella cittadina di Nome la difterite colpisce i bambini. Con i cani da slitta Balto e Togo, Leonhard e altri uomini del villaggio partono alla ricerca del siero curativo.

programme.desc: Spassosa commedia trascinata da un irrequieto cane San Bernardo, che provochera' epici disastri in una famiglia californiana. Ma di fronte al pericolo, tutti saranno pronti a difenderlo.

programme.title: La bussola d'oro

programme.title: Shaun, vita da pecora - Farmageddon
programme.desc: Il secondo film ispirato alla serie animata si tinge di fantascienza. Shaun e i suoi amici devono difendere dagli agenti del governo una piccola aliena atterrata nella fattoria.

programme.desc: Pellicola d'animazione dai creatori di "The Lego Movie". Le cicogne consegnano ormai i bebe' online, ma un imprevisto obbliga il loro miglior corriere a una corsa contro il tempo.

programme.desc: La star del wrestling John Cena in una commedia per tutta la famiglia. Una squadra di vigili del fuoco salva tre fratelli da un incendio in una casa di montagna. In attesa di rintracciare genitori, i pompieri scoprono di non essere affatto addestrati a fare i babysitter.

In un mondo interamente abitato da animali, il koala Buster Moon possiede uno storico teatro caduto ormai in disgrazia dopo i fasti del passato. Per risollevarne le sorti, organizza una gara di canto radunando una serie di incredibili aspiranti star. A contendersi la palma del migliore ci sono Mike, un topolino imbroglione, la timida elefantessa Meena e Rosita, una scrofa con 25 maialini da accudire. E poi Johnny e Ash: il primo e' un gorilla figlio di un gangster; la seconda e' una grintosa cantante punk.

Da allora ha coltivato il sogno di entrare nella famigerata agenzia segreta. Scoperto il quartier generale, convince l'agente O a concederle un periodo di prova. Al fianco di un collega deve smascherare una spia nella filiale di Londra, mentre una nuova stirpe di alieni minaccia il mondo. Spin-off della saga ispirata ai fumetti Marvel di Lowell Cunningham, il film e' diretto da F. Gary Gary, regista di "Fast & Furious 8'.

programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova ci raccontano quattro pellicole premiate a Venezia 2024, in prima visione nella collezione 'Film da Leoni', dal 27 agosto al 6 settembre.

programme.title: Blacklight
programme.desc: Liam Neeson e Aidan Quinn in un action Sky Original. Un ex agente federale e una giornalista rischiano la vita per portare alla luce un complotto che coinvolge i vertici dell'FBI.

programme.desc: Crimini, colpe e inganni con Jane Wyman e Marlen Dietrich nel thriller di Alfred Hitchcock. Il marito di una diva teatrale scompare e i sospetti ricadono sull'amante della donna.

programme.desc: Anthony Hopkins, Julianne Moore e Gary Oldman nel sequel di Ridley Scott. Fuggito dal manicomio, Hannibal Lecter si rifugia a Firenze, ma due vecchie conoscenze lo braccano.

programme.desc: Anthony Hopkins nei panni di Hannibal Lecter in un thriller con Edward Norton e Ralph Fiennes. Un detective consulta lo psichiatra criminale per catturare un killer detto Lupo Mannaro.

Hole e' convinto che l'omicidio sia legato ad altri delitti avvenuti in passato. In ballo c'e' dunque un serial killer da fermare e l'unico modo per evitare che uccida ancora e' prevenirne le prossime mosse. "L'uomo di neve' e' il settimo romanzo dedicato al detective Harry Hole, il primo adattato per il cinema.

programme.desc: La sublime regia di Alfred Hitchcock per un thriller psicologico con Tippi Hedren e Sean Connery. Un giovane industriale scava nel passato della moglie traumatizzata...

programme.desc: Anthony Hopkins nei panni di Hannibal Lecter in un thriller con Edward Norton e Ralph Fiennes. Un detective consulta lo psichiatra criminale per catturare un killer detto Lupo Mannaro.
